indonesianTerminology.title: Indonesian COVID-19 Terminology
indonesianTerminology.subtitle: Official Ministry of Health (Kemenkes) terminology for COVID-19 case classification
indonesianTerminology.officialNote: Official basis for COVID-19 data reporting as of 2021

kasusSuspect.name: Kasus Suspect
kasusSuspect.description: Person from an area with local transmission within 14 days before illness, or had contact with confirmed/probable case, or severe respiratory infection requiring hospitalization with no specific identified cause.

kasusProbable.name: Kasus Probable
kasusProbable.description: Clinical COVID-19 case with severe symptoms, ARDS or severe respiratory distress, not yet laboratory tested via RT-PCR.

kontakErat.name: Kontak Erat
kontakErat.description: Person who contacted a confirmed or probable case within the infectious period.

kasusKonfirmasi.name: Kasus Konfirmasi
kasusKonfirmasi.description: Positive RT-PCR test result with two subcategories: symptomatic and asymptomatic cases.

otg.description: Legacy term: Individuals who test positive for COVID-19 but show no symptoms. Now classified under confirmed cases (asymptomatic).

odp.description: Legacy term: Individuals monitored for 14 days after exposure. Now classified as Suspect Cases.

pdp.description: Legacy term: Patients with symptoms requiring medical supervision. Now classified as Probable Cases.

classificationProgression.title: Official Classification System
classificationProgression.description: Kemenkes updated terminology in 2021 for more precise epidemiological classification and reporting mechanisms
classificationProgression.officialQuote: This calculation basis will be used starting today for COVID-19 data reporting

home.metaTitle: PICO SulTeng API - COVID-19 data for Sulawesi Tengah
home.metaDescription: Province-level COVID-19 data for Sulawesi Tengah (Central Sulawesi), down to regency, hospital, task force and vaccination. Documented endpoints, formulas and data sources.
home.promise: Province-level COVID-19 data for Sulawesi Tengah, down to regency, hospital, task force and vaccination.
home.historicalNote: Historical data. Each figure carries the date of its record.
home.error: The latest records could not be loaded. The API may be unreachable.
home.offline: You are offline. Reconnect to load the latest records.
home.coversText: Six resource groups. Each row shows one real path and opens its page.

groups.service: Health check and the API index.
groups.national: National case records, from day 1 to the latest.
groups.regions: Cases for every province and the regencies of Sulawesi Tengah.
groups.facilities: Hospitals with bed availability, and task force posts with contacts.
groups.statistics: Cases by gender and age group, and COVID-19 tests.
groups.vaccination: National and Sulawesi Tengah vaccination, and vaccination sites.

home.methodsText: How each figure is defined, how the reproduction rate is estimated, which terms changed over time, and where the data comes from.

endpoints.apiIndex: API title, version and links to the endpoints.
endpoints.national: National case records, oldest first by default.
endpoints.nationalDay: National record for one day number.
endpoints.provinces: All provinces, each with its latest case record.
endpoints.provinceCases: Case records for one province. Use 72 for Sulawesi Tengah.
endpoints.regencies: Regencies and cities of Sulawesi Tengah.
endpoints.taskForces: Task force posts grouped by regency.
endpoints.genderStats: Cases by gender and age group, one record per day.
endpoints.genderLatest: The latest gender and age group record.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Start with one request, then learn the base URL, the response format and what the API covers.

endpoints.title: All endpoints
endpoints.description: One row per endpoint. Select a path to read its parameters and copy a working request. A tinted chip marks the paginated ones.

glossary.title: Data and methods
glossary.description: How the figures are defined and calculated, which terms changed over time, and where the data comes from.

authentication.title: Authentication and limits
authentication.description: No API key is needed. Read how the rate limit headers and CORS work.

errors.title: Errors and status codes
errors.description: What each status code means, a real error body, and what to do about it.

pagination.title: Pagination
pagination.description: Two paging styles, checked against the live API, and which endpoints use each.

health.title: Health check
health.description: Check that the API and its database are up.
health.body: Returns the service status, version, a timestamp and database connection counts. The home page calls this endpoint.

apiIndex.title: API index
apiIndex.description: The API title, version and a map of its endpoints.
apiIndex.body: Returns the API title and version, links to the OpenAPI files and Swagger UI, and the list of endpoints. The root path / serves this documentation site, not JSON.

nationalLatest.title: Latest national record
nationalLatest.description: Returns the most recent national COVID-19 record.
nationalLatest.body: The newest national record: daily and cumulative counts, case percentages and the reproduction rate when one exists. The date field is the date of the record, not today.

nationalHistorical.title: National history
nationalHistorical.description: Returns national records day by day, with paging, date filters and sorting.
nationalHistorical.body: By default the oldest record comes first. Pass sort=date:desc for the newest first. Dates that cannot be read are ignored. A record for a single day is at the day path shown below.

provinces.title: Provinces
provinces.description: Lists the Indonesian provinces, each with its latest case record.
provinces.body: Returns a plain array, so there is no paging. Each province carries its latest case record unless you exclude it.

provinceCases.title: Province cases
provinceCases.description: Daily and cumulative cases for all provinces, or for one province such as Sulawesi Tengah (72).
provinceCases.body: Put a province ID in the path for one province, for example 72 for Sulawesi Tengah. Without an ID, the cases path returns every province. The newest record comes first.

regencies.title: Regencies
regencies.description: Lists the regencies and cities of Sulawesi Tengah, with detail and case history.
regencies.body: The list pages with page and per_page. The detail and case history paths return the whole result without paging.

hospitals.title: Hospitals
hospitals.description: Hospitals in Sulawesi Tengah with bed availability and contacts.

taskForces.title: Task forces
taskForces.description: COVID-19 task force posts grouped by regency, with contacts.

genderStats.title: Gender statistics
genderStats.description: Cases by gender and age group for Sulawesi Tengah.
genderStats.body: Returns every record, one per day, as a plain array. Each record is nested by case type (positive and PDP), gender and age group. Use the latest path when you only need the newest record.

testStatistics.title: Test statistics
testStatistics.description: COVID-19 testing figures for Sulawesi Tengah.
testStatistics.body: Returns every record as a plain array: one per test type per day, each with its test type embedded.

testTypes.title: Test types
testTypes.description: The COVID-19 test types the API knows about.
testTypes.body: The sample and duration fields are written in Indonesian.

vaccinationNational.title: National vaccination
vaccinationNational.description: National vaccination records with daily, cumulative and coverage figures per group.
vaccinationNational.body: Each record has a total and a breakdown by group: health workers, the elderly, public officers, the public and teenagers. Figures are nested as daily, cumulative and coverage, for dose 1 and dose 2.

vaccinationProvince.title: Sulawesi Tengah vaccination
vaccinationProvince.description: Vaccination records for Sulawesi Tengah, in the same shape as the national ones.
vaccinationProvince.body: Same nested structure as the national endpoint, for province 72.

vaccinationLocations.title: Vaccination sites
vaccinationLocations.description: Vaccination sites in Sulawesi Tengah with address and opening hours.

overview.step1: Copy the request below and run it in a terminal. It needs no API key.
overview.step2: Read the JSON that comes back. The Response tab shows its shape.
overview.step3: Change the path to ask for something else.
overview.expect: You get an object with status "success" and a data object that holds the latest national record. The date field is the date of that record. Counts sit under daily and cumulative. The statistics object holds percentages and the reproduction rate, which can be null.
overview.historical: The API serves COVID-19 records that were already collected. It is not a live feed. Read the date field of a record before you quote a figure.
overview.methodValue: GET only. Every endpoint reads data.
overview.envelopeValue: A successful response has status "success" and the result in data.
overview.coverageText: Province-level COVID-19 data for Sulawesi Tengah, down to regency, hospital, task force and vaccination, plus national and all-province records for context. Data and methods explains the definitions and the sources.

authentication.noKey: Every endpoint is public. Send a plain GET request. There is nothing to sign up for.
authentication.limitsText: Every response carries two headers about the request limit. When this page was written, the limit header read 100.
authentication.limitHeader: The maximum number of requests allowed.
authentication.cors: Browsers can call the API directly: CORS allows any origin.
authentication.cache: Cache what you reuse instead of asking again.

errors.shapeText: When a request fails, the HTTP status tells you why. The body is JSON with status "error" and a message in the error field.
errors.fieldText: Read the error key, not message. Some messages are in Indonesian and some are in English.

200.title: OK
200.remedy: Read data, and check the date of the record.
200.when: A normal response. The body has status "success" and your data.

400.title: Bad request
400.meaning: A path or query value is not valid, for example a day that is not a number.
400.remedy: Fix the value and send the request again. Do not retry it unchanged.
400.when: This request asks for the day "abc", which is not a number.

404.title: Not found
404.meaning: The record or the path does not exist.
404.remedy: Check the code or ID against the list endpoint, then try again.
404.when: This regency code does not exist.

500.title: Server error
500.meaning: The server failed while it handled a valid request.
500.remedy: Wait a few seconds and retry with a growing delay. Check the health endpoint. If it keeps failing, open an issue on the source repository.
500.when: We could not trigger a 500 on demand, so the body below is a shape, not a captured response. It uses the same envelope as 400 and 404.

errors.note404: An unknown path is not JSON. The body is the plain text "404 page not found".
errors.note500: Shape only. No real 500 was captured.

pagination.intro: List endpoints page their results in one of two styles. Which style applies depends on the endpoint, so check the lists below. Everything on this page was checked against the live API.
pagination.pageText: Use page and per_page. The response carries a pagination object with page, per_page, total, total_pages, has_next and has_prev.
pagination.pageIgnored: These endpoints ignore limit, offset and all.
pagination.offsetText: Use limit and offset. The response carries a pagination object with limit, offset, total, total_pages, page, has_next and has_prev.
pagination.offsetIgnored: These endpoints ignore page, per_page and load_all. The page number in the response is worked out from offset and limit.
pagination.edgeAll: load_all=true (page style) and all=true (offset style) return every record as a plain array in data, without a pagination object.
pagination.edgeInvalid: A zero or non-numeric value falls back to the default. Large values are capped: per_page at 100 and limit at 1000.
pagination.edgePast: A page past total_pages returns status 200 with data set to null.
pagination.edgeNone: Some endpoints are not paginated. The provinces list, the statistics endpoints and each regency case history return a plain array.
